description: This file defines the abstract class 'SystemTarget' which serves as a base for various system services within the Orleans runtime, such as grain directory and reminder services. It includes methods for managing components, handling messages, registering timers, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: SystemTarget
classes.description: An abstract base class for system services in Orleans, providing message handling, timer registration, component management, and lifecycle control.

methods.name: GetComponent
methods.description: Retrieves a component of the specified type, with special handling for PlacementStrategy.

methods.name: SetComponent
methods.description: Sets or removes a component of the specified type.

methods.name: HandleNewRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming request messages by invoking the runtime client.

methods.name: HandleResponse
methods.description: Handles response messages received from the runtime client.

methods.name: RegisterTimer
methods.description: Registers a timer with a callback that takes an object as state.

methods.name: RegisterGrainTimer
methods.description: Registers a timer with a callback that takes a CancellationToken.

methods.name: RegisterGrainTimer
methods.description: Registers a timer with a callback that takes a CancellationToken and a specific state.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the SystemTarget.

methods.name: ToDetailedString
methods.description: Returns detailed string info about the current message being processed.

methods.name: GetOrSetExtension
methods.description: Gets or sets a grain extension, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: GetComponent
methods.description: Implementation of ITargetHolder.GetComponent, retrieves a component, with extension support.

methods.name: GetExtension
methods.description: Retrieves a specific grain extension, installing it if necessary.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Processes incoming messages, enqueuing requests or logging invalid messages.

methods.name: GetTarget
methods.description: Returns this object cast to the specified target type.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Placeholder for activation logic.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Placeholder for deactivation logic.

methods.name: Deactivated
methods.description: Task representing deactivation completion.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, including timers and system target counts.

methods.name: Rehydrate
methods.description: Disposes of the rehydration context if provided.

methods.name: Migrate
methods.description: Placeholder for migration logic, not supported.

methods.name: StopAllTimers
methods.description: Stops and disposes all registered timers.

methods.name: CheckRuntimeContext
methods.description: Verifies that the current runtime context matches this instance.
